name: Kobato Azusa
source:
Azusa is so unathletic that she can't do any sports, even tennis. She loves drinking tea with [url=/c98255]Himeno[/url] and [url=/c98389]Mari[/url]. She always keeps a smile on her face so that she can make others happy as well. Azusa also volunteers as a school nurse.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
